summary: Epic E11 Store Locations + Google Reviews feature testing completed. All backend APIs and frontend flows working correctly. Google Maps in EMBED mode (iframe, no API key) and reviews are MANUAL curated as expected.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/stores returns 3 locations with config (maps_mode=embed, reviews_source=manual, rating 4.5/3751)
Backend: GET /api/store-reviews returns 6 manual curated reviews
Backend: Admin login successful
Backend: GET /api/admin/store-locations lists 3 locations
Backend: POST /api/admin/store-locations creates new location
Backend: PUT /api/admin/store-locations/{id} updates location
Backend: DELETE /api/admin/store-locations/{id} deletes location
Backend: GET /api/admin/store-reviews lists 6 reviews
Backend: POST /api/admin/store-reviews creates new review
Backend: PUT /api/admin/store-reviews/{id} updates review
Backend: DELETE /api/admin/store-reviews/{id} deletes review
Backend: GET /api/admin/store-config retrieves config
Backend: PUT /api/admin/store-config updates config (rating_avg, rating_count, intro)
Backend: RBAC - GET /api/admin/store-locations without token returns 401
Backend: Validation - POST /api/admin/store-locations without name returns 422
Frontend: /lokasi page loads with hero 'Kunjungi butik kami'
Frontend: /lokasi page displays Google rating badge (4.5 · 3.751 ulasan)
Frontend: /lokasi page shows 3 store location cards
Frontend: Each location card has embedded Google Map iframe with valid src
Frontend: Each location has 'Petunjuk Arah' button (data-testid='store-directions-button')
Frontend: /lokasi page displays reviews section with 6 review cards
Frontend: Header navigation has 'Lokasi' link to /lokasi
Frontend: Footer has 'Lokasi Toko' link to /lokasi
Frontend: /kontak page loads with contact form
Frontend: /kontak page displays primary store map (data-testid='contact-store-map')
Frontend: /kontak page shows store locations section with 3 branch cards
Frontend: Admin login at /admin works with admin@collectorparfum.id / Admin#2026
Frontend: /admin/lokasi page loads with header (data-testid='admin-stores-header')
Frontend: Admin stores page has 3 tabs: Lokasi, Ulasan, Konfigurasi
Frontend: Lokasi tab displays table with locations (data-testid='admin-store-locations-table')
Frontend: 'Tambah Lokasi' button (data-testid='admin-store-location-add') opens dialog
Frontend: Location creation dialog allows adding new location with name and address
Frontend: Location save button (data-testid='admin-store-location-save') works
Frontend: Edit and delete buttons present for each location
Frontend: Ulasan tab displays table with reviews (data-testid='admin-store-reviews-table')
Frontend: 'Tambah Ulasan' button (data-testid='admin-store-review-add') present
Frontend: Konfigurasi tab displays config form (data-testid='admin-store-config')
Frontend: Config form has maps mode selector (data-testid='admin-store-maps-mode') showing 'Embed (tanpa API key)'
Frontend: Config form has reviews source selector (data-testid='admin-store-reviews-source') showing 'Manual (kurasi)'
Frontend: Config form has rating avg/count inputs (4.5 / 3751)
Frontend: Config form has intro textarea
Frontend: 'Simpan Konfigurasi' button (data-testid='admin-store-config-save') present
